---
description: Improve WordSifter responsiveness without redesigning it
agent: WordSifter Builder
---

Review the user-named area, or the full page when none is named, for desktop, tablet, and mobile behavior.

Fix overflow, cramped controls, weak wrapping, unreadable type, awkward grid collapse, and touch-target problems while preserving the existing visual identity. Prefer targeted CSS changes. Do not introduce a new component library or redesign unrelated sections. Validate after editing and summarize each responsive improvement.
